tei:div.tei:p: (na)༄/ /kyai rdo rje man ngag lugs kyi mchod gtor gyi rnal 'byor bzhugs// ༈ bla ma dang dpal kyai rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor brgyad las mchod gtor gyi rnal 'byor bye brag tu bshad pa la don brgyad de/ dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba/ mchod pa bsham pa'i bya ba/ tshogs zhing spyan drang ba'i bya ba/ phyag 'tshal ba/ mchod pa dbul ba/ rgyun bshags bya ba/ sdom pa gzung ba/ gtor ma gtang ba'o/ /dang po ni/ thun bzhi la sogs par byed na tho rangs kyi dus su thun 'gor byas te/ bsam gtan gyi khang pa dben zhing nyams dga' bar byi dor legs par byas la/ sa'i phyogs gang 'os pa der maṇ+ḍal khru gang tsam gyi dbus nas dri bzang gi chus dbang ldan du cung zad 'then te gru bzhir byug cing oṃ me dī ni badz+rī bha wa ban+dha hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ 'og thams cad rdo rje'i sa gzhir gyur zhes brjod/ yang mtha' skor du byug cing oṃ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phyogs dang steng thams cad rdo rje'i rwa ba dang / gur dang / bla res bskor bar gyur zhes brjod de/ dbus su me tog bzhag nas lag pa bteg ste/ de lta bu'i srung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su skad cig gis gzhal yas khang pa gru bzhi pa sgo bzhi pa zhes pa nas/ rgyan du mas brgyan pa'i gzhal yas khang par gyur zhes pa'i bar dang / de'i phyi rol du dur khrod chen po brgyad/ de dag la gnas pa'i shing chen po brgyad/ shing gi rtsa ba la gnas pa'i phyogs skyong ba brgyad/ steng gi nam mkha' la gnas pa'i sprin chen po brgyad/ de dag la gnas pa'i klu chen po brgyad/ shing gi yal ga la gnas pa'i zhing skyong brgyad/ gzhan yang ro mgo bo bcad pa dang zhes pa nas/ 'gyel zhing gdong gyen du phyogs pa'i gdan dang bcas par gyur zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin bsgom mo/ /de nas dbus su me tog gi tshom bu spungs la/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du oṃ hūm̐ shrī he badz+ra ya na maḥsnying po kyai rdo rje sku mdog sngon po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug zhes pa nas/

gar dgu'i ro dang ldan pa nyid ces pa'i bar brjod/ yang de nyid du me tog gcig bzhag la/ de'i pang na nam̐ nai rāt+ma na maḥyum rdo rje bdag med ma sku mdog sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma zhes pa nas/ yab yum gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o zhes pa'i bar gsal gdab/ de nas phyogs mtshams brgyad du me tog gi tshom bu bzhag la rim pa bzhin du shar du gam̐ gau rī na maḥgo rī nag mo g.yas gri gug g.yon nya ro hi ta 'dzin pa/ lhor tsam̐ tsau rī na maḥtsau rī dmar mo/ nub tu bam̐ bai tā lī na ma ཿbai tā lī ser mo/ byang du gham̐ ghasma rī na maḥghasma rī ljang gu/ byang shar du paṃ puk+ka sī na maḥpuk+ka sī sngon mo/ shar lhor sham̐ sha ba rī na maḥri khrod ma dkar mo/ lho nub tu laṃ tsaṇ+ḍa lī na maḥgadol pa mo sngon mo/ nub byang du ḍam̐ ḍom bhi nī na maḥgayung mo kha dog sna tshogs pa g.yas rdo rje g.yon sdig mdzub mdzad pa/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma zhes pa nas ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o zhes pa'i bar zhal phyag rdzogs par gsal btab bo/ /gnyis pa ni/ dkyil 'khor de'i g.yas rang gi g.yon phyogs nas brtsams te zhabs bsil dri zhim po'i chu dang / zhal bsil 'o ma'am mngar gsum blug pa dang / 'thor 'thung chu gtsang dang / mchod yon chu gtsang la me tog dkar po blug pa rnams rim pa bzhin bsham/ de'i g.yon rang gi g.yas nas me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas rnams rim pa bzhin bsham/ dkyil 'khor gyi byang shar la nye bar 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma phud las chung bar byas pa gzhag de'i g.yas su 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma lhag ma las che bar byas pa gzhag chos skyong gi gtor ma byed na de gnyis kyi bar du rim pa bzhin gzhag go /rang gi mdun du rdo rje dang / dril bu dang / nang mchod gsum g.yas nas rim pa bzhin gzhag gzhan yang rol mo la sogs pa mchod pa'i yo byad gang 'byor pa rnams kyang ji ltar 'tshams pa'i gnas su gzhag go

/gsum pa ni/ rang kyai rdo rje phyag gnyis pa'i nga rgyal du dran par byas la stan la 'dug ste/ rang gi lag pa g.yas pa hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa lte bar raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la hūm̐/ lag pa g.yon pa āḥlas pad+ma 'dab ma lnga pa lte bar zla ba la āḥ de rnams zhu ba las byung ba'i rdo rje'i lag par gyur zhes brjod/ de nas lag pa gnyis rnam lnga 'dod pa'i skor ba byas te/ lag pa g.yas par rdo rje blangs nas oṃ ma hā badz+ra hūm̐ zhes brjod cing / smin mtshams kyi bar du lan gsum gsor la thugs kar bzung ste/ thog ma dang tha ma med pa'i byang chub kyi sems thugs kyi dam tshig zhes brjod cing dran par bya/ yang lag pa g.yon pas dril bu blangs shing oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe aḥzhes brjod de lan gsum dkrol la dkur kha gyen la bstan te bzung la/ srid pa thams cad rang bzhin gyis dag pa ston par byed pa'i gsung / chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong gi ngo bo gsung gi dam tshig zhes brjod cing dran par bya/ rang dpal kyai rdo rje phyag gnyis pa rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo sku phyag rgya'i dam tshig ces brjod cing dran par bya/ de nas dril bu phyogs mtshams brgyad du dkrol zhing / oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba bud dha k+ṣe ṭa pra tsa li te pradz+nyā pa ra mi ta nā da sam+bha we ta badz+ra dharma hṛ da ya ni/ san+to ṣa ni hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho a khaṃ swā hā/ oṃ e h+ye hi bha ga wān mahā kā ru ṇi ka he badz+ra sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ye dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥzhes brjod de/ sems kyis rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis sangs rgyas/ byang sems/ bla ma dang bcas pa thams cad kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i rnam par spyan drangs nas mdun du bskyed pa la gnyis su med par thim par bsam mo/ /bzhi pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo de nyid bla ma yin par mos nas/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid/

/skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang / /bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku/ /rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud/ /'khor ba'i 'dam tshogs nang gnas pa/ /thugs rje'i phyag gis 'dren mdzad cing / /ye shes bdud rtsis tshim mdzad pa/ /bla ma'i zhabs kyi pad+mor 'dud/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ /slob dpon la ni bdag skyabs mchi/ /dang por me tog phog pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'dud/ /ces bya ba la sogs pa brjod cing phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas yang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i rnam par mos nas/ thams cad dngos po'i rang bzhin mchog /ces sogs kyai rdo rje'i bstod pa dang / gzhan yang sangs rgyas dang byang sems kyi bstod pa ci shes kyis bstod par bya'o/ /lnga pa la/ phyi dang / nang dang / yid las byung ba dang / bstod pa'i mchod pa bzhi las/ dang po ni/ mchod pa rnams la nang mchod gtor zhing / oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pas bgegs bskrad/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswabhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes pas stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i zhabs bsil/ zhal bsil/ 'thor thung / mchod yon/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra nī rī ti hūm̐ khaṃ swā hā zhes pa nas/ oṃ badz+ra shab+da āḥhūm̐ zhes pa'i bar sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlab/ de nas rdo rje khu tshur gnyis dku g.yon par kha sprad la/ mtshan sngags brjod pa'i tshe rnam lnga 'dod skor byas la mchod sngags kyi tshe so so'i phyag rgya bcas nas/ se gol phar gtog pa'i tshe snying ga nas mchod pa'i lha mo spros te mchod par bsam/ tshur gtog pa'i tshe snying gar bsdus nas ngag tu/ dri med yid du 'ong ba yi/

/lha rdzas dam pa'i zhabs bsil 'di/ /bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /oṃ bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka he badz+ra sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra nī rī ti hūm̐ khaṃ swā hā/ de bzhin du tshigs bcad dang / sngags gzhan rnams 'dra bar byas nas zhal bsil dang / ni wi ti hūm̐ kham̐/ 'thor 'thung dang / sarba saṃ sho dha ni/ mchod yon dang / dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥkhaṃ raṃ ma hā ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha zhes pa rnams sbyar ro/ /de nas/ me tog 'di ni bzang zhing dge /dag pa'i skye gnas las dag pa/ /bdag gi dad pas 'bul lags kyis/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /sngags gzhan rnams 'dra ba las/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ tshal dag ro ni phan pa dang / /gang zhig dri dang bdug spos mchog /bdag gi dad pas 'bul lags kyis/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /oṃ badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūm̐/ srin po 'joms shing dag byed la/ /dge zhing mun pa rnams sel ba/ /bdag gi dad pas 'bul lags kyis/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ 'di ni dri bzang dge ba ste/ /dag pa'i skye gnas las dag pa/ /bdag gi dad pas 'bul lags kyis/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐/ sman rnams bcud gtsang yi gar 'ong / /sngags kyi zhal zas shos 'di dag /bdag gi dad pas 'bul lags kyis/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /oṃ badz+ra nai wi d+yā āḥhūm̐/ dri med yid du 'ong ba yi/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i rol mo 'di/ /bdag gi dad pas 'bul lags kyis/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /oṃ badz+ra shab+da āḥhūm̐ dang / ghaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi sogs brjod cing rol mo dbul lo/ /gnyis pa ni/ bdud rtsi gtor ma bzhin byin gyis brlabs la/ lag pa g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis g.yon skor du lan gsum bskor nas dbus nas blangs te spyi bor gtor zhing ngag tu/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa/

mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje/ mdzad pa'i phrin las bsam gyi mi khyab pa mnga' ba drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rdo rje 'chang / bdag med ma/ bir+wa pa/ nag po pa/ ḍā ma ru pa/ a wa dhū ti pa/ ga ya dha ra/ 'brog mi shākya ye shes/ bla ma se mkhar chung ba/ zhang dgon pa ba/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'gro ba'i mgon po chos rgyal 'phags pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ na bza' brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ grub pa'i dbang phyug bud+dha shrī/ thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga' bzang po/ rje btsun dam pa dkon mchog rgyal mtshan rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang / dbang bskur/ rgyud bshad/ man ngag gnang / chos kyi 'brel pa thob pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha la rtsa sngags dang / snying po dang / yum gyi phreng sngags kyi mthar oṃ āḥhūm̐ btags la gtso bo yab yum la dbul/ de nas oṃ āḥgaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes sogs lha mo brgyad kyi sngags kyi mthar oṃ āḥhūm̐ btags la dbul zhing / bya ba'i rgyud/ spyod pa/ rnal 'byor/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang 'brel ba'i yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod cing dbul lo/ /de nas srin lag gis lce rtse/ smin mtshams/ spyi gtsug tu thig le byas pas/ lus kyi lha thams cad tshim par bsams la oṃ āḥhūm̐ brjod/ de nas oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ye oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas gur mgon dang / oṃ shrī dharmā pā la tsa tur mu kha oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas gdong bzhi pa la sogs pa sgos kyi chos skyong gang byed la dbul/ gzhan yang chos 'khor bsrung zhing bstan pa skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/

gnas dang nye ba'i gnas/ zhing dang nye ba'i zhing / tshan+do dang nye ba'i tshan+do/ 'du ba dang nye ba'i 'du ba/ 'thung gcod dang nye ba'i 'thung gcod/ dur khrod dang nye ba'i dur khrod/ yul sum cu so gnyis/ gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ dur khrod brgyad na bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ sprul pa'i skus 'gro ba sems can gyi don mdzad pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhing skyong bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad/ pho nya gnas las skyes pa/ rigs las skyes pa/ sngags las skyes pa/ las las skyes pa'i mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang / gnas gsum gyi rdo rje mkha' 'gro rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang gnod spyin/ srin po/ 'byung po/ yi dwags/ sha za/ smyo byed/ brjed byed/ ma mo/ zhing skyong / pho nya/ 'phrog ma/ grub pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bod khams skyong bar byed pa'i bstan ma bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa dang / gnas bdag gzhi bdag grong bdag yul bdag gnyug mar gnas pa rnams dang / 'gro ba rigs drug lam rgyud lnga/ skye gnas rnam pa bzhis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad tshim zhing / zag pa med pa'i bde bas rgyud gang nas/ myur du bla na med pa'i go 'phang thob pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig ces pa'i mthar oṃ āḥhūm̐ btags la dbul/ de nas oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas rang gi lce la myangs te oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ ta swa dā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod/ gsum pa ni/ rang gi snying ga nas sprul pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par bsam zhing rdo rje gsor dril bu gsil te/ ngag tu/ nam mkhar rje btsun bltas nas ni/ /zhes pa nas/ g.yung mos sku la 'khyud pa nyid/ /ces pa'i bar brjod do/ /bzhi pa ni/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs yongs su bskor/ /zhes sogs dang / thams cad dngos po'i rang bzhin mchog /zhes sogs bstod pa nyi shu pas bstod par bya'o/ /drug pa ni/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/

/zhes sogs rgyun bshags lan gsum bya'o/ /bdun pa la/ rigs lnga spyi dang bye brag gi dam tshig gzung ba ni/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /zhes sogs lan gsum bya'o/ /rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig gi tshogs rjes su dran pa la/ spang bya dran pa ni/ kun nas dwang bas bla ma yi/ /zhes pa nas/ nyin re bzhin ni bzla bar bya/ /zhes pa'i bar rtsa ba'i ltung ba yan lag dang bcas pa'i gzhung lan gcig brjod do/ /bsten bya dran pa ni/ ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /dkon mchog gsum ni rtag tu gzung / /rtag tu dam tshig bsrung bar bya/ /rdo rje dril bu'ang gzung bar bya/ /gtsug tor rtag tu bcang bar bya/ /rtag tu sbyin sreg dgang bar bya/ /rtag tu dkyil 'khor bzhengs par bya/ /rtag tu bde gshegs rab gnas bya/ /'byung po che la gtor ma sbyin/ /phyag rgya bcing ba rnam spangs shing / mchod rten las ni mi bya ste/ /rdo rje gsum mchog phyag mi bya/ /dkyil 'khor la sogs lus kyi las/ /rmi lam du yang mi bya'o/ /slob dpon gzhan la phyag mi bya/ /bla ma'i rgan rabs phyag 'tshal lo/ /rtag par rgyun du sngags bzla zhing / /bsam gtan nyid kyang 'bral mi bya/ /rtag tu slob ma bsdu bya zhing / /rtag pa ru ni bshad par gyis/ /rtag tu sems can bskyang bar bya/ /rtag tu sangs rgyas cher mnyes bya/ /dzam bha la la chu sbyin zhing / /las rnams thams cad yang dag spyad/ /bye ma'i las la mchod rten yang / /mkhas pas cho ga bzhin du bya/ /zhes lan gcig brjod de/ rgyun bshags nas 'di'i bar thal mo snying gar sbyar te don dran bzhin du bya'o/ /brgyad pa ni/ gtor ma nang mchod chu chang gis sbyangs te sgrub thabs ltar byin gyis brlabs nas mgron bskyed pa'i tshe/ mdun bskyed kyi dur khrod chen po brgyad du hūm̐ brgyad yongs su gyur pa las shar du brgya byin zhes sogs phyogs skyong brgyad gsal gdab/ mdun bskyed kyi dbang ldan gyi dur khrod kyi steng gi cha la e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa'i nang du pam̐ las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba dang /

'dab ma brgyad la oṃ dgu yongs su gyur pa las dbus su sku rdo rje zhes sogs dang / mdun bskyed kyi srin po'i dur khrod kyi 'og gi cha la e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa'i nang du pam̐ las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba dang / 'dab ma brgyad la āḥdagu yongs su gyur pa las dbus su gsung rdo rje zhes sogs gsal gdab/ gzhan rnams sgrub thabs dang 'dra ba las ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa'i tshe rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rnam par spyan drangs nas dgug gzhug bya/ rigs bdag gis rgyas gdab pa'i tshe phyogs skyong brgyad la mi bskyod pa/ sku rdo rje lha chen brgyad dang bcas pa la rnam par snang mdzad/ gsung rdo rje klu chen brgyad dang bcas pa la 'od dpag tu med pas dbur brgyan zhes brjod/ gzhan rnams sgrub thabs ltar ro/ /de nas chos skyong rnams la'ang gtor ma 'bul na'ang skabs 'dir phul la/ de nas 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma la/ lag pa g.yas g.yon dbus gsum bstan te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥzhes pas sngar gyi byin rlabs dran pas bya ste/ de nas 'jig rten pa'i mgron spyan drangs pa ni phaiṃ gyi sgra dang 'bar ba'i phyag rgya byas la oṃ badz+ra ā ral+li ho dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ badz+ra ḍā ki n+yaḥs ma ya satwaṃ dṛ sh+ya hoḥzhes brjod cing / sems kyis snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis 'dzam bu'i gling na gdod nas grub pa'i dur khrod brgyad spyan drangs la/ sngar gyi dur khrod brgyad la gnyis su med par bstim par bya'o/ /de nas rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ ngag tu/ oṃ kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ sarba yak+ṣa rak+ṣa sa/ bhū ta/ pre ta/ pi shā tsa/ un+mā da/ a pasmā ra ḍā ka ḍā ki n+ya da ya/ i maṃ ba liṃ gṛ han+tu sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu ma mā sarba sid+dhi me pra yats+tshan+tu/ ya thai waṃ ya thais+ṭaṃ buñdza tha dzi ga tha/

pi pa tha/ ma ti kra ma tha/ mā ma sarba karta ya sad su khaṃ bi shud+dha yi sa ha yi ka bha wan+tu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes lan gsum brjod pas dur khrod kyi bdag po rnams mnyes par bsam par bya'o/ /de nas phyi dang nang mchod kyis mchod nas dril bu dkrol zhing / lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /ces pa'i bar brjod nas rdo rje'i glu dang / bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad dang / bsngo ba smon lam rnams sgrub thabs ltar bya/ de nas gur nas 'byung ba'i yi ge brgya pa'i mthar muḥ zhes brjod de mtheb srin gyis se gol gtog la ye shes pa gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa rnams dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas rang gi snying gar bsdus la/ dkyil 'khor gyi tshom bu rnams dbus su bsdu/ mchod pa dman ma rnams chu bor dor ba'am gnas dben par bzhag la las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o/ /'di dag ni thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa'i tshe thun gyi thog mar bya ba yin pas thun mtshams kyi bya ba zhes kyang bya/ mchod gtor gyi rnal 'byor zhes kyang bya/ las dang po pa'i bya ba zhes kyang bya/ phyi rol tshogs bsag gi rnal 'byor zhes kyang bya ste rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi man ngag rin po che bsod nams rtse mo'i gsung rab las 'byung ba ltar dag par bris pa yin la/ deng sang dgu gtor la sogs pa'i dus su bdag bskyed sngon du btang nas chos skyong gi gtor ma dang phyogs gcig tu byed pa'i lag len gyi tshul ni/ sa'i phyogs gang 'os pa der maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su dri bzang gi chus thig le byas nas tshom bu dgu bkod/ de'i mthar byang shar du mtshams 'dzin gyi me tog shar du zhabs bsil dang zhal bsil/ shar lhor 'thor 'thung / lhor mchod yon/ lho nub tu me tog nub tu bdug spos dang mar me/ nub byang du dri chab/ byang du zhal zas rnams kyis bskor ba'am/ yang na maṇ+ḍal gyi mdun du byang shar nas brtsams te shar lho'i bar du gtor ma lnga rim pa bzhin du bshams nas de'i mdun du sngar gyi mchod pa rnams phreng tshar du bsham pa yang mdzad do/

/de nas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas nas brtsams te/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa'i bar byas nas dkyil 'khor bsdus te/ rang gtso bo yab yum gyi nga rgyal du gnas nas mchod pa rnams sngar bshad pa ltar byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /de nas maṇ+ḍal la rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod gtor nas/ a mṛ tas bsang / swa bhā was stong par sbyangs te stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje shar dkar zhes sogs sgrub thabs ltar gsal btab nas/ oṃ me dī ni zhes sogs lan gsum dang / oṃ rak+ṣa zhes sogs lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlab bo/ /de lta bu'i srung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su e las chos kyi 'byung gnas zhes pa nas 'byung bzhi 'khor lo dang bcas pa'i bar sgrub thabs ltar gsal btab nas/ de rnams dang rang gi sems snang ro gcig tu 'dres pa las/ rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang pa/ gru bzhi pa sgo bzhi pa zhes sogs rten dang brten pa'i dam tshig pa bskyed pa ni sngar dang 'dra'o/ /de nas mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma zhes pa nas thugs kar thugs rdo rje ma zhes pa'i bar skye mched dang sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs nas lag pa byin gyis brlab pa nas bzung ste/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo spyan 'dren pa'i bar snga ma ltar byas la/ chu bzhi sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod kyis mchod nas oṃ badz+ra gau rī ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes sogs kyis dgug gzhug bya'o/ /de nas sgrub thabs ltar dbang lha spyan drangs te/ chu bzhi sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod kyis mchod nas/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun zhes sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi zhes sogs kyis bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ lus thams cad gang dri ma thams cad dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso bo yab yum gau rī dang puk+ka sī la mi bskyod pa zhes sogs sgrub thabs ltar rgyas btab/

de nas rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas mdun gyi nam mkhar rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi rnam pa can la brgyud pa'i bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dam pa chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes pas tshogs zhing khyad par ba spyan drangs la phyag 'tshal nas/ gtor ma dang po 'das pa la 'bul ba'i bar snga ma ltar byas la/ gtor ma gnyis pa nag po chen po lcam dral/ gsum pa zhal bzhi pa/ bzhi pa las mgon/ lnga pa mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyis phul nas chos skyong gi bshags pa dang / bstod pa sogs skabs dang bstun nas bya/ de nas 'das pa'i gtor ma bar chad zhi ba'i ched du gzhag gzhan bzhi po spyi bstab brjod cing sa gtsang sar bskyal/ nang du log nas mchod pa rnams bsang sbyang byin gyis brlabs nas sngags tsam gyis phyi mchod dang nang mchod dbul/ dkar mo ri dwags sogs dang / khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs sogs kyis bstod nas yi ge brgya pa lan gsum dang / ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang zhes sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol nas ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rnams bdag la bsdus nas skye mched dang sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /'dir sgrub thabs su kha 'phangs pa rnams ni rje bla ma mus pa chen po'i sgrub thabs yin la/ rang gi gzhung man ngag gi snang ba'i kha bskang du yang 'gyur ba 'di ni mang du thos pa'i dge slong bsod nams seng ges bris pa'o// ༈ /mtsho skyes lugs kyi phra mig bzhugs lags/ bla ma dang dpal kyai rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /slob dpon chen po mtsho skyes kyi lugs kyi kyai rdo rje'i mngon par rtogs pa man ngag lugs kyi yan lag bzhi pa dang / thun mong ba rnams der kha 'phangs shing mi 'dra ba rnams 'dir brjod na/ tshogs zhing spyan drangs nas/ lha mo brgyad kyis mchod pa 'dra/ rgyun bshags ni gang zhig thog ma med pa'i 'khor bar ngan pa'i rnam par rtog pa las skyes pa bdag gis sdig pa'i las bgyis pa de thams cad bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar bshags shing yang mi bgyid do/

/so so'i skye bo dang / 'phags pa nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang / rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi dge ba de thams cad la yi rang bar bgyi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi dge ba de thams cad ces pa yan chad snga ma bzhin brjod nas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngo bar bgyi'o/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba bla ma dang / gtso bo sangs rgyas dang / sngags la sogs pa chos dang / 'khor dge 'dun la bdag kyai rdo rje'i go 'phang ma thob kyi bar du skyabs su mchi'o/ /snang grag gi chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa yin pa la de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du bdag gis mtshan ma med pa'i byang chub kyi sems bsgom par bgyi'o/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams zhes sogs tshigs bcad gnyis dang bcas pa lan gsum brjod/ de nas tshad med bzhi dang / ye shes kyi tshogs dang / thun mong ba'i srung 'khor 'dra/ de'i nang du chos kyi 'byung gnas kha dog dkar por bsgoms pa'i nang du 'byung bzhi lugs bzlog la rang sems 'dres pa las gzhal yas khang bskyed pa 'dra/ gdan bskyed pa'i skabs su dbus dang phyogs mtshams brgyad du pam̐ las pad+ma dang / ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor re re/ dbus kyi nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ phung po dang / nyon mongs pa dang / 'chi bdag dang / lha'i bu'i bdud kyi ngo bo tshangs pa dang / nye dbang dang / dbang po dang / drag po rnams mnyam par brtsegs pa/ phyogs mtshams brgyad du shar du tshangs pa sogs 'dra/ de nas gdan dgu'i steng du ā li phrag gnyis las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsgoms nas snod bcud sbyang ba'i bar phal cher 'dra la/ lha mo dbyung ba ni sa bon 'gros yin/ gtso bo'i phyag g.yas kyi bdun pa na khyi/ brgyad pa na ma he ni bdag mdun thams cad du khyad par ro/ /de nas skye mched dang sku gsung thugs byin brlab mi byed par/

ye shes kyi 'khor lo dgug gzhug dang / dbang bskur rigs bdag gi rgyas gdab phal cher 'dra ba las/ dbang gi chu rgyun gcig la dbang bzhi blangs pa tsam yin gyi mthar rten gyi rgyan cha'i dag pa sogs gsum po 'dir mi bzhed/ de nas bskyed rim gyi sems 'dzin tshul lha dgu la sems 'dzin pa dang / gtso bo yab yum tsam la sems 'dzin pa dang / yab tsam la sems 'dzin pa'i gang zag gi blo rigs gsum las/ dang po skabs 'dir sems 'dzin byed/ gnyis pa khams gsum snod bcud nas gtso bo yab yum gyi bar bsdus nas sems 'dzin byed/ gsum pa yum dang yum rang gi snying ga'i zla nyi am̐ gsum la bsdu/ de yang 'od kyi gong bur byas nas sna bug g.yon nas rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ la bsdus te yab rkyang la sems 'dzin byed/ de nas rdzogs rim la yang hūm̐ tsam la sems gnas pa dang / nā da tsam la sems gnas pa dang / de yang mi dmigs pa'i stong nyid la sems gnas pa gsum po gang rung bsgoms nas slar yang gtso bo yab yum gyi skur langs te/ thun gtor gtong ba'am/ spyod lam la 'jug pa'am/ mdun bskyed la 'jug pa gang rung bya'o/ /de dag gang ltar yang gtso bo yab yum tsam du gnas pa'i dus der/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi pa'i lte ba'i aṃ las kyi phyag rgya zhes sogs phyag rgya bzhis rgyas gdab/ spro na gtum mo 'khor lo bzhi'i dmigs pa rgyas gdab pa bsgom pa yang gsungs/ de nas spyi bo'i 'khor lo mi bskyod pa zhes sogs rgyan drug gi dag pa dang / dbang po'i gnas rnams su pam̐ las pad+ma dang / ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du/ mig tu maṃ las gti mug rdo rje ma dkar mo zhes sogs skye mched dang sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab/ de nas bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor 'dra/ de nas yum bsdu ba nas thun mtshams kyi lhar langs pa'i bar snga ma bzhin byas nas/ snying rje'i spyan ni dmar po la/

/zhes sogs dang / gzugs kyi phung po ni gau rī'o/ /gzugs phung rdo rje ma yin te/ /zhes sogs dang / zhe sdang zhes bshad rdo rje ma/ /zhes sogs dang / gzugs la gau rīr rtag tu bshad/ /ces sogs dang / glo dang dbugs dang de bzhin smyo/ /zhes sogs kyis dag pa dran par bya/ spyod lam la 'jug na rdo rje'i glu dang smon lam bya ste thun gtor sogs la 'jug go /sgrub thabs kyi phra mig go/ //ras bris la brten pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga la spyi 'gro ni chu gsum gyi mchod yon byang shar du bsham pa nas mchod pa brgyad phyogs mtshams brgyad du bsham/ mchod yon gyi sngags oṃ pra wa ra sad ka ra dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥkhaṃ raṃ ma hā ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes dang / zhabs bsil zhal bsil sogs kyi sngags 'dra/ yan lag bzhi rdzogs rnams la ye shes kyi 'khor lo dgug gzhug gi rjes su skye mched dang sku gsung thugs byin brlab bya/ cho ga la sta gon dang / dngos gzhi gnyis las/ dang po sa lha sta gon ni/ sngon 'gro rnam gsum 'dra/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du bam̐ las sa'i lha mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rin po che'i bum pa 'dzin pa yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed nas mchod gtor 'dra/ skyob pa sangs rgyas sogs dang / skyob pa shākya sogs tshigs bcad gnyis kyis gsol ba gdab/ sa'i lha mo nam mkhar bteg ste dpang po'i tshul gyis bzhugs par bsam/ sta gon gyi dus su srung 'khor dang / chos 'byung gi nang du gzhal yas khang skad cig gis bskyed pa'i nang du pam̐ las pad+ma dang / oṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dgu'i steng du sgrub thabs ltar gyi gdan bskyed/ de rnams kyi steng du lha dgu sa bon las bskyed ye shes pa spyan drangs nas phyi mchod dang lha mo brgyad kyis mchod/ lha mo bzhis dgug gzhug bya/ yan lag lhag ma gnyis 'dra/ mchod pa la dri med yid 'ong sogs chu gsum la 'don pa bsgyur/

nang mchod kyi skabs su/ rdo rje 'chang / bi la s+ya/ yan lag med pa'i rdo rje/ grub chen mtsho skyes/ in+d+ra bhū ti/ lcam lak+ṣimā/ nag po spyod pa ba dang / bram ze dpal 'dzin/ ga ya dha ra/ 'brog mi/ se ston/ zhang dgon pa ba/ sa chen/ rta stag so ba khu dbon/ dpal chu bo ri pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ na bza' brag phug pa/ ri khrod pa dpal ldan pa/ rje ngor pa/ rje mus pa rnams kyi mtshan nas brjod/ gzhan phyi mchod/ nang mchod/ na bza'i mchod pa rnams 'dra/ bstod pa la dkar mo ri dwags sogs kyi rjes su/ srid pa rang bzhin gyis dag phyir/ /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems pa rnams/ /dam pa'i srid pa byed par shog /ces dang / bstod thung dang / bstod ring gis bstod/ gtor ma 'dra/ de nas bdug spos thogs te rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ gnyis med ye shes las byung ba/ /khyab bdag dngos kun bdag nyid can/ /ston pa'i gtso bo khrag 'thung dpal/ /bdag med ma dang yang dag ldan/ /phyogs dang mtshams kyi mkha' 'gro dang / /rig pa'i lha mo rdzu 'phrul can/ /byang chub sems dpa' la sogs kun/ /ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /slob ma la ni phan pa dang / /khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /rdo rje can bdag 'di zhes pas/ /nangs par dkyil 'khor 'bri bar bgyid/ /rjes su brtse bar nyer dgongs te/ /byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab bo/ /slob ma sta gon la/ lus kyi bya ba 'dra/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i bsam pa bskyed pa ni/ gsang sngags spyod pa'i skal ldan zhing / /sngags kyi dngos grub don gnyer gang / /zhes sogs brjod/ nang dbang bskur ba'i skabs su/ yum gyi mkhar sku rdo rje rnam snang 'ba' zhig tu bskyed nas dbang bskur ba'i rjes su he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis par gyur par bsam ste sbyor mtshams nas phyung ste gral la bzhag khyad par can gyi don zhu ba dang /

gsang sngags la spro ba bskyed pa 'dra/ de nas nang gi sems bskyed pa ni bde mchog bzhin dam tshig nyer gnyis 'dzin pa tshig tha ma la bdag gis sdom pa legs par gzung zhes sbyar ba lan gsum bzlas nas/ bdag gis sdig pa bgyis pa dang / /bgyid du stsal dang yi rang ba/ /sangs rgyas spyan sngar mchis nas su/ /de dag thams cad bshags par bgyi/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /rang rgyal dgra bcom 'gro rnams kyis/ /bsgoms dang bzlas brjod bsod nams tshogs/ /de la bdag ni yi rang ngo / /sems bskyed mngon par sangs rgyas dang / /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs spyod pa/ /de dag la ni skyabs su mchi/ /sangs rgyas 'byung ba ji lta bar/ /skal ldan byang chub sems dpa' yis/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed pa ltar/ /'di nyid du ni sems bskyed do/ /mgon po bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /ma lus bzhugs shing sangs rgyas rnams/ /dus 'di nyid nas sangs rgyas bar/ /bla med bdag la gzigs su gsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad lnga dang / tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang / /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig dang / bdag gi dge ba'i las rnams 'di dag gis/ /'jigs rten mi ring sangs rgyas myur bsgrubs nas/ /sems can 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor bying ba rnams/ /bla med byang chub nyid du bsgral bar bgyi/ /zhes lan gsum brjod/ bsrung ba ni dpral bar oṃ las 'khor lo oṃ gyis mtshan pa sogs bsgoms nas yas rim gyis reg pa kho na bya/ mchod pa zhal zas med gzhan 'dra/ de nas so shing / khyor chu/ ku sha/ dpung skud rnams 'dra/ bsang gtor gyi tshe 'bru gsum brjod cing bdud rtsi gtor/ de nas chos zab mo bshad pa dang / rmi lam brtag cing ngan na bsrung ba 'dra/ bum pa sta gon ni/ bh+rūm̐ las bum par bskyed pa'i nang du/ lha sta gon gyi skabs ltar gdan dang yan lag bzhi rdzogs bya/

gzhan 'dra/ rjes chog bya'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ ras ris bkram pa'i mthar mchod gtor sta gon gyi skabs ltar bshams nas sngon 'gro rnam gsum dang / yi ge brgya pas dam tshig bshags pa sngon du 'gro bas tshogs gnyis bsags pa ji lta ba bzhin du bsgom/ srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa na rdul tshon gyi srung 'khor dang tha mi dad cing yan lag bzhis gzhal yas khang bskyed pa'ang rdul tshon dang tha mi dad du mos/ mngon byang lngas gtso bo bskyed pa dbus kyi mtshan ma dang tha mi dad du bya zhing gsal gdab cing mkha' gsang byin gyis brlab/ snyoms par zhugs pa'i stobs kyis dkyil 'khor bsgrubs te/ 'du shes gsum dang ldan pas snyoms par zhugs pa'i sgras phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad g.yon nas zhugs/ rjes chags kyi mes snying ga'i thad kar zhu/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar thig le'i gzugs kyis bab pa las lha dgu gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa rdzogs par bskyed/ de nas gtso bo yab yum las yab yum dpag tu med par gyur te spros pas phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du khyab pas/ sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa zhe sdang dang rnam par shes pa'i phung po sbyangs nas chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes rgyud la skyes/ rnam pa yab yum 'ba' zhig tu gyur nas don byed pa dang byas pa gnyis ka tshur 'dus te bdag nyid la thim/ gau rī dpag tu med par gyur te spros pas/ sems can thams cad kyi gzugs kyi phung po dang nyon mongs pa gti mug sbyangs nas me long lta bu'i ye shes kyi rtogs pa rgyud la skyes/ rnam pa gau rī 'ba' zhig tu gyur te gnyis ka tshur 'dus nas gau rī'i mtshan ma la thim pas gau rī gcig tu gyur te/ rnam pa gsal gdab pa la sogs pa'o/ /mtshams kyi bzhi la puk+ka sī las puk+ka sī dpag tu med par gyur te 'phros pas sems can thams cad kyi 'byung ba sa'i rtog pa sbyangs nas byams pa tshad med pa rgyud la bskyed nas puk+ka sī'i rnam par gyur nas gnyis ka 'dus te puk+ka sī'i mtshan ma la thim pas puk+ka sī gcig tu gyur pa la sogs pa sbyar ro/

/gzhal yas khang spros te/ gzhal yas khang nyid la thim pas gzhal yas khang nyid kyang snod kyi 'jig rten dang ro gcig tu gyur par bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas ye shes sems dpa' sta gon gyi dus su nam mkha' la bteg nas yod pa de nyid la lha mo brgyad kyis mchod/ bstod pa thung ngus bstod/ rtsa ba'i sngags brjod pas bgegs bskrad la gau rī la sogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / sngags dang phyag rgyas dgug gzhug bcing dbang du byas la yi ge brgya pas brtan par bya/ gtso bo la skye mched drug dang / sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab/ dbang bskur rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas gdab bo/ /de nas skabs 'dir ma bshad kyang bdag bskyed kyi bzlas pa phyag len la mdzad do/ /de nas gtso bo las bdag nyid phyag gnyis pa'i rnam par phye la mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa nas 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma gshegs su gsol ba'i bar sta gon gyi skabs ji lta ba bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /phyi rol gyi gtor ma mi dgos/ slob ma la dbang ci ltar bskur ba ltar rang nyid bdag 'jug gi tshul du blangs nas slob ma 'jug pa ni slob ma rnams khrus byas/ yon dang maṇ+ḍal phul/ slob dpon gyis chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu zhes sogs tshigs bcad gnyis lan gsum gyis bden pa'i stobs brjod/ slob ma sku rdo rje rnam snang du dran par byas la/ gdong bcing ba dang / me tog gi phreng ba gtad pa dang / bum chus bsang ba dang / 'dod pa dri zhing lan gdab pa dang / slob ma he ru ka phyag gnyis par bsgoms pa'i snying gar zla ba rdo rje sems bskyed pa rnams 'dra la/ brtan byed kyi sngags kyi rjes su rang gi sems nyid rig pa byang chub kyi sems bde ba chen po thabs dang / shes rab gnyis su med par rtogs par gyis shig ces brda sprad/ de nas gsang bar gdams pa dang / nang du gzhug pa 'dra/ nang 'jug ni/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/

/slob dpon la ni skyabs su mchi/ /gtso bo lha mor bcas pa yi/ /lha rnams la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon pos bdag ni gzhug par 'tshal/ /don dam smra ba'i seng ge zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig dang bcas pa lan gsum gyis slob mas bla ma la gsol ba gdab/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad lan gsum gyis bla mas dkyil 'khor gyi lha la gsol ba gdab/ slob mas oṃ na ma te hūm̐ zhes sogs kyis dkyil 'khor gi lha la phyag bya/ de nas sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /zhes pa nas/ mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus byos/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis sdom pa bsgrags nas/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs lan gsum gyis gzung / de nas dam la gzhag pa bzhi 'dra/ 'di ni khyod kyi zhes sogs mi dgos/ ye shes dbab brtan dang / kha dog dri ba dang / me tog dor 'ching dang / mig phye ba rnams 'dra la/ mig phye ba'i tshigs bcad kyi rjes su oṃ badz+ra nai tra sogs brjod de/ dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ /da ni dad pa rab tu bskyed/ /khyod ni rnal 'byor ma rigs skyes/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ /'gro ba'i phun tshogs dngos grub dang / /dngos grub kun khyod kun tu 'gyur/ /dam tshig thams cad bskyang bya dang / /gsang sngags la yang brtson par gyis/ /zhes brjod pas spyir bstan la gang la me tog phog pa de nyid khyad par du bstan no/ /de nas lha gzhan yang thun mong du ming dang sku mdog phyag mtshan gyi sgo nas gtso bo dang / g.yung mo'i bar du rim pa bzhin bstan no/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi de kho na nyid bstan pa ni gzhal yas khang gru bzhi par byung ba ni tshad med pa bzhi rnam par dag pa'i rang bzhin no/ /sgo bzhi ni dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi rnam par dag pa'i rang bzhin no/ /rta babs bzhi ni yang dag par spong ba bzhi rnam par dag pa'i rang bzhin yin no/

/drwa ba ni nyon mongs pa chen po rnam par dag pa'i rang bzhin no/ /drwa ba phyed pa ni nye ba'i nyon mongs pa chung ngu rnam par dag pa'o/ /ka ba brgyad ni 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad rnam par dag pa'o/ /dar na pa ti la sogs pa rnams ni tshul khrims rnam par dag pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /'dod pa'i yon tan ni gzugs sgra la sogs pa rnam par dag pa'i rang bzhin no/ /rdo rje rwa ba ni zab mo'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i rtags so/ /me 'od ni phyin ci log gi bgegs la sogs pas mi tshugs pa'i rtags so/ /bum pa brgyad ni che ba'i yon tan gyis rgyas shing thugs rje chen po'i ros yongs su gang ba'i rtags so/ /lha'i de kho na nyid bcom ldan 'das kyai rdo rje ni rnam par shes pa'i phung po dang zhe sdang rnam par dag pa'i rang bzhin no/ /gau rī ni zhe sdang dang gzugs rnam par dag pa'i rang bzhin no/ /chom rkun ma ni gti mug dang sgra rnam par dag pa'i rang bzhin no/ /ro langs ma ni nga rgyal dang dri rnam par dag pa'i rang bzhin no/ /ghasma rī ni 'dod chags dang ro rnam par dag pa'i rang bzhin no/ /puk+ka sī ni zhe sdang dang sa rnam par dag pa'i rang bzhin no/ /ri khrod ma ni gti mug dang chu rnam par dag pa'i rang bzhin no/ /gtum mo ni nga rgyal dang me rnam par dag pa'i rang bzhin no/ /g.yung mo ni 'dod chags dang rlung rnam par dag pa'i rang bzhin no/ /bdag med rnal 'byor ma ni yab dang mthun no/ /de nas dngos gzhi ni maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ he ru ka dpal dbang bskur ba/ /zhes sogs lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ slob dpon lha yi nga rgyal brtan po dang ldan pas bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags brjod cing yungs kar gyis brdeg gu gul gyis bdug bdud rtsi gtor bas bgegs bskrad/ rdo rje'i rwa ba la sogs pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lo yang bsgom/ rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pa bteg ste rol mo dang bcas pas phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba nas/

lnga po des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /zhes pa'i bar dang / dza ya dza ya sid+dhi sid+dhi rgyal bar gyur cig rgyal bar gyur cig ces bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad brjod do/ /de nas oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥzhes brjod la/ me tog gi phreng ba me tog phog pa'i lha de nyid la 'bul/ me tog lhung ba blangs la mgo la bcings shing oṃ dharmā kuṇ+ḍa li a bhi ṣiñtsazhes brjod/ de nas bdag dang slob ma dang bum pa'i chu gsum ka swa bhā wa'i sngags kyis stong par sbyangs pa'i ngang las/ hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las mi bskyod pa zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa g.yas brgyad rdo rje dang / g.yon brgyad des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa yum mā ma kīs 'khyud pa bskyed gsum ka la ye shes pa dgug gzhug bya/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis dbang bskur gyi lha gdan gsum tshang ba spyan drangs nas nam mkhar bzhugs pa la oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ sarba ta tha ga ta zhes gsol ba btab pas khro bo'i gzugs su gyur te/ oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa mi taṃ zhes gsungs nas bdag dang bum pa'i lha gnyis la dbang bskur bas lus thams cad khengs pas zag pa med pa'i bde bas gang / chu lhag ma yar lud pas mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan par bsams la mchod pa lngas mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa ci rigs pa bzlas/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig dang / srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ces sogs tshigs bcad gcig brjod la bum pa'i nang gi mi bskyod pa yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa zhu ba las bum pa'i chur gyur par bsam pa lag tu bzung ste slob ma'i spyi bor dbang bskur/ sems kyis phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bum pa byang chub kyi sems kyis gang bas dbang bskur bas lus mtha' dag khengs te/ zag pa med pa'i bde bas rgyud gang nas chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pa zhi bas dbur brgyan par bsam/

mi bskyod pa'i sgo nas chu'i dbang bskur ba thob/ rnam par shes pa'i phung po dang zhe sdang gnas gyur te chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes dang / mi bskyod pa'i ngo bo nyid du gyur par mos la mchod pa lngas mchod do/ /cho ga'i 'gros 'di 'og ma rnams la yang sbyar/ de nas bdag dang cod paṇa dang / slob ma gsum āṃ las rin po che āṃ gis mtshan pa las rin 'byung ser po rtsa ba'i zhal ser/ g.yas sngo/ g.yon dkar/ zhal lhag ma rnams nag pa/ phyag bcu drug gis thod pa bcu drug bzung ba'i g.yas pa rnams na rim pa bzhin/ bya ka raṇ+ḍa/ ngur pa/ lug bye'u tsa ko ra/ bye khra/ hor khra/ 'ol ba/ nya khra/ g.yon pa rnams na stobs kyi rgyu/ dung skyong / rigs ldan/ pad+ma/ pad+ma chen po/ 'jog po/ nor rgyas/ mtha' yas rnams 'dzin pa/ yum rin chen sgrol ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng na bdud bzhi brtsegs pa'i gdan la zhabs g.yas gnyis brkyang / g.yon gnyis bskum pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal dang / phyag rgya drug gi rgyan dang ldan pa bskyed/ ye shes pa gzhug pa dang sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab pa 'dra/ dbang lha re re nas spyan 'dren par gsungs kyang sngar nam mkhar bzhag pa de nyid kyis chog pas/ de la gsol ba btab pas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis 'og nas 'byung ba'i tshigs bcad dang sngags kyis bdag dang dbang rdzas kyi lha gnyis la rin po che'i cod paṇa bcings pas zag pa med pa'i bde ba chen po mngon du byas shing spyi bor rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan pa la mchod pa lngas mchod/ oṃ āḥ.āṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā zhes ci rigs bzlas/ rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab/ /sogs dang / srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /sogs brjod/ dbang rdzas kyi rin chen 'byung ldan yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa las cod paṇa du gyur pa de lag tu bzung la/ thor tshugs cod paṇa gyis brgyan pa/

/sangs rgyas kun gyis bsngags pa'o/ /rin po che yi dbu rgyan dang / /dar dpyangs dbang bskur sbyin par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra ba ra ta ka hūm̐ badz+ra a ra li ho zhes dang / oṃ badz+ra rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa zhes brjod la ting nge 'dzin snga ma dang 'dra bas rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan par bsam/ bshad pa lnga snga mas 'gre/ mchod pa lngas mchod do/ /'od dpag med rdo rje'i dbang la gsum ka dz+rīṃ las pad+ma dz+rīṃ gis mtshan pa las snang ba mtha' yas rtsa ba'i zhal dmar/ g.yas nag g.yon dkar ba/ g.yas pa rnams na dom/ bya rgod/ bse/ ba men/ stag spre'u/ chu srin na kra/ lce spyang / g.yon pa rnams na kha/ 'ug pa/ bya dkar/ seng ge mtsho gnas/ ra/ kṛṣ+ṇa sa ra/ phag rnams 'dzin pa/ yum gos dkar mo dang mnyam par sbyor ba bskyed/ yan lag gnyis 'dra/ dbang lha la gsol ba btab pas de dag gis rdo rje rtse dgu pa bdag dang dbang rdzas 'od dpag med du bskyed pa'i lag pa g.yas su gtad pas zag pa med pa'i bde ba chen po mngon du byas te 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan pa la/ mchod pa/ sngags/ bstod pa/ dbang rdzas zhu ba'i bar 'gre/ de nas rdo rje slob ma'i lag tu gtad de/ sangs rgyas rdo rje'i dbang gis ni/ /de ring khyod la dbang bskur 'gyur/ /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /bzang grub phyir ni rdo rje gzung / /zhes dang / thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis sbyin te/ ting nge 'dzin snga ma dang 'dra bas 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan bshad pa lnga 'gre/ mchod pa lngas mchod do/ /de nas gsum ka khaṃ las don yod grub pa ljang gu rtsa zhal ljang / g.yas gnag g.yon dkar/ g.yas pa rnams na gza' lhag phur bu/ mjug rings/ sgra gcan/ mig dmar/ pa sangs/ spen pa/ khyab 'jug g.yon pa rnams na dbang po/ tshangs pa/ drag po/ bdud sdig can/ lha ma yin gyi bu mo gshol mda' 'dzin/ lha rgyal ba dam pa/ thags bzangs ris/ lha ma yin stobs ldan rnams 'dzin pa/

yum dam tshig sgrol mas 'khyud pa bskyed/ yan lag gnyis 'gre/ dbang bskur gyi lha la gsol ba btab pas/ de dag gis bdag dang dbang rdzas kyi lag pa g.yon du dril bu gtad pas bde ba chen po mngon du byas shing don yod grub pas dbur brgyan pa la mchod pa/ sngags/ bstod pa/ dbang rdzas zhu ba'i bar 'gre/ de nas gsol ba btab pas/ 'di ni rnal 'byor ma kun gyis sogs dang / srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag sogs dang / oṃ badz+ra a dhi sogs kyis dril bu lag pa g.yon du gtad 'khyud pa'i tshul gyis 'dzin du gzhug des zag pa med pa'i bde ba mngon du byas nas spyi bor don grub kyis dbur brgyan par bsgom/ bshad pa lnga dang / mchod pa 'gre/ de nas bdag dang slob ma gnyis bh+rūm̐ las rnam snang dkar po g.yas nag g.yon dmar/ g.yas na rma bya/ ma he/ chu srin ma ka ra/ nya ro hi ta/ rus sbal/ 'og gi klu/ ngang skya/ ri bong / g.yon pa rnams na sbal pa thu bo/ sprin shugs/ sbrul ha la/ rtsangs pa nag po/ byi ba/ g.yag gla ba/ bya bzhad rnams 'dzin pa/ sangs rgyas spyan mas 'khyud pa bskyed/ yan lag gnyis dang / bdag nyid la mchod pa sogs 'gre/ ming gi dbang 'dra/ bshad pa lnga dang mchod pa 'gre/ de nas slob ma mi bskyod pa'i nga rgyal 'dzin du bcug la/ thun mong gi brtul zhugs 'dra/ tshigs bcad la he ru ka dpal sbyar/ thun mong ma yin pa'i brtul zhugs ni slob ma he ru ka'i nga rgyal 'dzin du bcug la/ ka pā la mi dmigs pa las ka pā la nyid du bskyed pa snying khar 'dzin du bcug la zag pa med pa'i bde ba chen po'i ye shes skyong ba'i mtshon byed du bstan/ kha ṭāṃ ga gru mor 'dzin du bcug tshangs pa'i skud pa nyis rim se ral khar bcings la/ rig pa byang chub kyi sems de yang thabs shes rab gnyis med yin pa'i tshon byed du bstan/ g.yas su oṃ las bskyed pa'i gri gug dang ḍā ma ru byin la chos thams cad stong pa nyid ston pa'i chos kyi sgra'i mtshon byed dang nga rgyal la sogs pa'i skyon drug gcod pa'i mtshon byed yin no zhes brda sprad de/

he ru ka dpal kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /rnal 'byor ma ni ḍā ma ru/ /rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ rdo rjer bcas/ /dril bu sil sil sgra sgrogs shing / /tshangs pa'i skud thogs rnal 'byor bdag /gri gug dang ni ka pā la/ /dpa' bo chen pos blang bar gyis/ /dpal he ru ka'i sku gsung thugs rdo rje dang mi 'bral bar gyis shig pa'i brda yin no zhes brjod/ de nas maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ dpa' bo chen po mi ldog pa'i/ /dbang bskur ba ni bdag la stsol/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag ni rtag tu slob dpon bgyid/ /zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ slob ma seng ge'i khri'i steng du pad zla'i gdan la rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhag pa la bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad sngon du 'gro bas rdo rje'i dam tshig dang / de kho na nyid 'dra/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong gi brjod bya rang gi sems nyid rig pa byang chub kyi sems nyid yin pa mtshon byed du bstan/ dril bu'i dam tshig 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad sogs dang / srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe aḥzhes brjod la steng 'og tu bsnol te 'khyud pa'i stangs ka byas la sems nyid gnyis su med pa'i rjod byed chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong gi mtshon byed du bstan/ de nas rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum rdo rje snyems ma lo bcu drug ma lta bu gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ pad zla'i steng na rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs par bsgoms la/ rdo rje rab gnas rdo rje nyid sogs tshigs bcad gcig dang / de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur/ /sngags dang rgyud rnams 'dzin gyur par/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /lha rnams kyis kyang mthun par gsungs/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin du ni/ /khyed kyis nan tan bskyed la bris/

/sgrub pa po rnams sngags la sbyor/ /zhes brjod de nyon mongs pa dang phung po thams cad dag pas dbyings dang ye shes dbyer med pa'i ngo bo rnam pa rdo rje sems dpar gyur par bsam mo/ /brtan byed kyi chus dbang bskur mi bskyod pas rgyas btab nas/ des lus kyi dri ma dag pa'i rtags lus rnam snang du gyur par dran par bya'o/ /mtha' brten rjes gnang la bzhi las/ lha mchod pa'i rjes gnang dang / sems can gyi don byed pa la mig thur me long gnyis 'dra/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i rjes gnang ni/ sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /'jig rten kun du thams cad du/ /bya ba spyod tshul gsang ba yi/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gyis/ /zhes brjod la 'khor lo rkang pa'i bar du sbyin/ khyod kyis the tshom dogs med par/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis dung byin la 'bud do/ /dngos grub bsgrub pa'i rjes gnang ni/ /zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang dgug /sdang bar bya dang gnod sogs dang / /gsod dang bskrad pa thams cad de/ /las de rnams ni bsgrub par gyis/ /ral gri mig sman sa 'og dang / /mchil l+h+wam de bzhin ril bu ste/ /rnal 'byor ma yi dngos grub sgrub/ /de ni ci dgar bsgrub par gyis/ /zhes brjod do/ /de ltar na ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du zhugs nas bum pa'i dbang bcu gcig thob pas lus kyi dri ma dag rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig bsrung ba la dbang / rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang thob nas theg pa dman par mi ldog pa'i cha nas sa brgyad pa'i byang chub sems dpa' dang skal ba mnyam pa zhes bya'o zhes brda sprad do/ /de nas gsang dbang gi yon du phyag dang maṇ+ḍal phul te/ khyod ni he ru ka dpal te/ /bde gshegs rnams kyi bde spel mdzad/ /byang chub sems dpa' che rnams kyis/ /yang dag don mchog rnam dag pa/ /ci ltar de nyid bdud rtsi yi/ /dbang gi mchog ni bskur ba bzhin/

/de bzhin bdag la 'khor ba yi/ /sdug bsngal rnams ni sel bar mdzod/ /rnal 'byor bdud rtsi dri med mchog /ma rig nyes pa'i rab rib 'joms/ /gang phyir byang chub bla med pa/ /de ring bdag gis thob par mdzod/ /zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ de nas bla mas shes rab ma bdag med mar bskyed de yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bya/ mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs nas snyoms 'jug bya ste/ rang gi ye shes sems dpa'i thugs ka'i mtshan ma'i lte ba'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros te/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams spyan drangs te/ thugs kar thim pas rjes chags kyi mes bzhu nas byang chub kyi sems nor bu'i rke ru phyin pa dang / a nu rā ga sogs brjod nas rjes su chags pa'i rdo rje'i rang bzhin nga yin no zhes nga rgyal bya/ de nas byang chub kyi sems bo la'i kha rker mtheb srin gyis mnan la slob ma'i khar drangs te/ nye bar longs spyod la bde bar mnos shig ces bsgo/ des kyang e ma re bde zhes brjod la 'thungs pa'i rjes la bde ba chen po dpal he ru ka'i bdag nyid ni bdag go zhes brjod/ de nas dkyil 'khor dang / dbang dang / dri ma dang / dam tshig snga ma'i rigs bsgres nas sa bcu pa'i byang chub sems dpa' dang skal ba mnyam par 'gyur ro zhes brjod/ mtha' brten lung bstan ni slob dpon gyis g.yon pas chos gos kyi grwa rta'i rna ba ltar bzung / g.yas pas mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya byas te/ 'di ltar nga yis lung bstan te/ /he ru ka dpal de bzhin gshegs/ /dngos po mchog tu grub pa'i phyir/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las bton/ /shrī she ru ka nā ma sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi sa ma ya satwaṃ bhur bhu waḥswaḥzhes pa'i mthar che ge mo zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs par 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan te/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis lung bstan par 'gyur ro zhes nges pa'i shes pa bskyed do/

/de la dga' ba bskyed pa ni gzengs bstod pa'o/ /de nas dbugs dbyung ba ni khams gsum gyi ni rgyal srid che/ /zhes pa nas thob 'gyur 'di la the tshom med zhes pa'i bar tshigs rkang drug dang / dbang 'di bskur ba tsam gyis ni/ /slob ma yon tan bdag por 'gyur/ /slob dpon nyid kyang bde ba yi/ /brtan g.yo kun gyi dam tshig yin/ /zhes brjod de de'i don yang bshad do/ /de la dga' ba skyes pas gzengs bstod pa ste dbugs dbyung zhing gzengs bstod pa'o/ /de nas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi don du phyag dang maṇ+ḍal phul ba dang / gsol ba gdab pa sngar bzhin byas te/ bla mas shes rab ma sngar ltar yan lag bzhi rdzogs su byas nas shes rab ma dang slob ma la bka' bsgo bar bya ste/ khyod kyis 'dod chags spang du mi rung gi dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyis kyang thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med pa'i rol pa mdzad pa las ye shes cher skyes te mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa yin pas/ khyod kyis kyang 'dod chags spang du mi rung ste gnyis su med pa'i rol pa byos shig ye shes skye bar 'gyur gyi zhes brjod nas shes rab mas/ khyod kyis nus sam rdo rje can/ /dri chen dri chu'i bza' btung dang / /rak+ta ga pur māṃ sa dang / /bud med mos pas dad nus sam/ /bha gar 'o byed mi rtog gam/ /smros shig rdo rje bde ba can/ /zhes dris/ slob mas/ lha mo ci phyir bdag mi dad/ /dri chen sa bon sogs za zhing / /shes rab yang dag dad par bgyid/ /bha ga la yang 'o bgyid do/ /zhes lan brjod/ de nas shes rab ma gcer bur phyung la/ khrus byas nas dri zhim pos byugs te gcer bur me tog gi phreng ba mgo la bcings la lag pa gnyis kyis dril bu gnyis bzung nas kha phye la 'di skad brjod do/ /rmad byung nga yi pad+ma 'di/ /thams cad bde ba yang dag ldan/ /rtag tu rim bzhin 'di la spyod/

/'di dang nam yang mi 'bral lo/ /chos dbyings 'di ni rnam par dag /sems can khams ni rnam par grol/ /khrag 'thung rgyal po 'di nyid ni/ /rang bzhin thams cad 'di la gnas/ /nang gi rtsa yi 'khor lo la/ /pad+ma la zhugs rab tu zung / /bha ga'i nang du nam mkha' bzhin/ /'byung ba lnga po rgyas shing 'chang / /lte ba la ni ge sar bcas/ /'dab ma brgyad kyis rnam par brgyan/ /de yi dbus nas 'byung ba yin/ /de nyid bdud rtsi shu kra'i gzugs/ /bhañdzā mok+ṣa ho/ /zhes brjod cing pang du byon par bsam/ de nas 'du shes gsum ldan sngon du song ba'i sgo nas snyoms par zhugs pas byang chub kyi sems bo la'i rker phyin pa las mi rtog pa'i ye shes skye bar 'gyur bas ji ltar gnas pa'i bar du bsgom mo/ /des ma thub na kak+ko lar phyung la de nyid lces blangs te myangs pas de las ye shes skye bas na shes rab ye shes kyi dbang zhes bya'o/ /de la dga' ba rnam pa bzhi ni/ dga' ba dang / yang dag pa'i dga' ba dang / rang bzhin gyi dga' ba dang / khyad par gyi dga' ba dang bzhi'o/ /de la dga' ba ni bi tsa ya na bya ba nas bo la'i rtsar phyin pa'i bar ro/ /yang dag pa'i dga' ba ni dkyil du phyin pa tsam mo/ /rang bzhin gyi dga' ba ni bo la'i rker phyin pa la bya ste/ de ni mi rtog pa bskyed par byed pa'o/ /'o na de gar gtogs pa yin zhe na/ smras pa 'khor lo bzhi'i rang bzhin dang mnyam par bya bar ro/ /'o na khyad par dga' ba'i grangs su mi 'gro na dga' ba ni gsum las med pas 'khor lo bzhi dang dga' ba bzhi ji ltar sbyar zhe na/ smras pa khyad par yang dga' ba'i grangs su 'gro ste/ gang gi phyir dga' ba chen po med kyang skad cig ma'i dga' ba'i grangs tsam yod pas kyang mi 'gal lo/ /rgyud las kyang dga' ba bzhi char bstan pas 'khor lo bzhi dang sbyar ba mi 'gal lo zhes bya ba la sogs pas ni shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba yin no/

/des ni yid kyi nyes pa thams cad dag par byed pas thugs kyi dbang zhes bya'o/ /de lta bu'i dbang thob pa'i rnal 'byor pa ni rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas dang skal ba mnyam par 'gyur ro/ /dbang bzhi pa ni gzhung na med kyang phyag len la man ngag lugs ltar mdzad do/ /rjes kyi cho ga 'dra'o/ /mtsho skyes lugs kyi phra mig la/ /man ngag lugs kyi phra btab pa'i/ /cho ga'i dbu rgyan gon 'dod pa/ /dag gi don du 'di sbyar ro/ /rgyus med rnams kyis 'di mthong na/ /lhag chad nyes pas gos nyen yod/ /rgyus can gcig la tshegs med par/ /cho ga dag cing tshang ba 'byung / /-ithi/ ka ran+ta dang ngur pa dang / /lugs dang byi'u tsa ko ra/ /bye khra hor khra 'ol pa nya/ /stobs kyi rgyu dang rigs ldan dang / /dung skyong pad+ma pad chen dang / /'jog po nor rgyas mtha' yas 'dzin/ /rin chen sgrol mas legs par 'khyud/ /thor tshugs cod paṇa gyis brgyan pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis rab bsngags pa'i/ /rin chen dag gi cod paṇa dang / /dar dpyangs dbang bskur sbyin par bya/ /dom dang bya rgod de bzhin bse/ /ba men stag dang spre'u dang / /chu srin lce spyang g.yas pa na/ /khwa ta 'ug pa bya dkar dang / /seng ge sa ra sa dang ra/ /kriṣ+ṇa sa ra phag rnams 'dzin/ /gos dkar mo dang gnyis med sbyor/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang / /gza' lhag phur bu mjug rings dang / /sgra gcan mig dmar pa sangs dang / /spen pa khyab 'jug g.yas pa na/ /dbang po tshangs pa drag po bdud/ /gshol mda' 'dzin dang lha dam pa/ /thags bzangs ris dang stobs ldan 'dzin/ /sgrol ma dang ni gnyis med sbyor/ /rma bya ma he chu srin nya/ /rus sbal klu dang ngang skya dang / /ri bong g.yas kyi thod pa na/ /sbal pa thu bo sprin shugs dang / /sbrul dang rtsangs pa byi ba g.yag /gla ba bya bzhad g.yon na 'dzin/ /sangs rgyas spyan dang gnyis med sbyor/ /shu bhaṃ// ༄/ /sam+bu ṭa'i cho ga'i gsal byed bzhugs//

bla ma dang dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor rdo rje dbyings kyi sgrub pa'i thabs kyi skabs su thugs kar yig 'bru'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs par gyur pa'i rjes su sa bon tsam las lha sum cu rtsa bdun bskyed pa'am rdo rje cho ga gsum las bskyed pa 'dam kha can du gnad kyi gsal byed las gsungs pas/ de gnyis gang rung gis phyogs gcig tu bskyed/ de nas 'byin sngags kyis phyir phyung ste mdzad pa mdzad nas so so'i gdan gyi steng du 'khod pa las zhal phyag gsal gdab bo/ /rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i skabs su gnad kyi gsal byed las de nas zhes bya ba la sogs pa ste/ de nas ni tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i rjes la zhes bya ste/ tshogs yongs su rdzogs pa des 'og min gyi gnas su bdag nyid mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas de'i rjes la ri rab la sogs par sprul bshad byed pas na brten bskyed pa de'i phyi nas so/ /yang na tshogs yongs su rdzogs pas sa bcu pa'i dus su zhing yongs su dag pa 'byung bas dang por rten bskyed la de nas bdag nyid 'tshang rgya ba 'byung / de nas dkyil 'khor du lha sprul pa 'byung ngo / /de ltar tshul gnyis su slob dpon bha bi'i lhas kyang gsungs so/ /de la lugs phyi ma ni gong du bsnyen pa'i skabs su bstan zin la/ 'dir rten bskyed pa phyi'i rdul tshon byin gyis brlabs pa dang 'brel bas phyis byas na bde'o/ /spyir du na gang byas kyang 'gal ba med do/ /de bas na de nas zhes bya ba ni tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa de nas so/ /'di la lnga ste rang gi sems so sor rtog pa zhes pa nas mngon byang lnga'i cho ga rgyas par gsungs te mjug tu/ de ltar de yan chad ni dang po rnal 'byor gyi ting nge 'dzin te ngo bo nyid kyi sku'o/ /dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog bstan pa'i phyir thabs dang shes rab kyi sbyor ba byas pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'byung bar bstan pa ni de nas yang byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba la sogs pa ste don ni 'di yin te/

rdo rje dang pad+ma byin gyis brlab par byas te snyoms par zhugs pa las de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs te/ zhal nas zhugs te thugs kar 'od du zhu ste/ byang chub sems kyi thig le yum gyi bha gar phab la/ de las so so'i sa bon du bskyed zhes bya ba'i don to/ /'di ni gnas bskyed pa'i rjes la sbyar ro zhes dang / brten pa lha bskyed pa ni hūm̐ gi sngags zhes bya ba la sogs pa ste/ sngar bstan pa bzhin yi ge'i dkyil 'khor bskyed la de nas gtso bo'i sa bon yi ge hūm̐ rang gi thugs ka nas phyung ste dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bkod la/ der mngon par byang chub pa lnga las gtso bo bskyed par bya'o/ /de nas 'khor bskyed pa ni shar du ni rnam par snang mdzad do zhes bya ba la sogs pa ste/ sa bon tsam las bskyed pa'am yang na cho ga gsum las bskyed par bya'o zhes gsungs/ 'di dag gi don sngon 'gro rnam gsum sngon du song nas yi ge brgya pa'i bsgom bzlas nas bzung ste/ ye shes tshogs bsag gi bar byas nas stong pa'i ngang las mngon par byang chub pa lnga las bdag nyid gtso bo yab yum gyi skur bskyed/ de nas rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ yaṃ hūm̐ nas gdan bskyed pa'i bar sgrub thabs ltar byas pa'i rjes su/ rang gtso bo yab yum gyi mkha' gsang byin gyis brlab pa nas thugs kar yig 'bru'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa'i bar byas la/ de'i dbus kyi yi ge hūm̐ bton nas mdun bskyed kyi dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du bkod pa rang gi sems so sor rtog par bsam pa nas mngon byang lngas gtso bo yab yum gyi skur bskyed/ de nas rnam snang la sogs pa'i 'khor rnams thugs kar sa bon las bskyed pa'am cho ga gsum las bskyed pa gang rung byas nas phyir spros te mdzad pa mdzad pa'am ma mdzad kyang rung ste/ so so'i gdan gyi steng du bkod nas zhal phyag gsal gdab/

de nas sta gon gyi lha gzhug pa sogs dkyus bzhin no/ /'di ni 'og min gyi gnas su bdag nyid mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas de'i rjes su ri rab la sogs par sprul bshad byed pa'i don yin la/ yang tshogs yongs su rdzogs pas sa bcu pa'i dus su zhing dag pa 'byung ba'i dbang du byas nas tshogs gnyis bsags pa'i rjes su rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor gdan bcas bskyed nas/ bdag nyid mngon byang lnga las gtso bo yab yum du bskyed/ de nas mkha' gsang byin gyis brlab pa nas bzung ste mdun gyi lha bskyed pa snga ma dang 'dra'o/ /bdag mdun tha mi dad ma yin kyang bsres shing 'byung ba'i bsgrub tshul 'di ni rgyud 'grel khyad par can 'di'i lugs thun mong ma yin par snang ngo / /rje bla mas thog mar bdag bskyed dag pa dran pa'i dbang du byas nas mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor bsgrub par gsungs pa ni las dang po pa cho ga rgyas shing dmigs pa gsal ba'i dbang du mdzad pa yin la de'i ltar na yang mdun bskyed kyi lha bsgrub pa'i tshul ni snga ma de bzhin du bya ba dgongs pa yin la/ sa chog dang ma 'brel ba'i lha sta gon dang / bum pa sta gon gyi skabs su yang gtso bo bdag bskyed kyi snying ga'i hūm̐ phyir phyung ste mngon byang lnga las bskyed pa dang / 'khor rnams bdag bskyed kyi thugs kar rdo rje cho ga gsum mam sa bon las bskyed pa gang rung byas nas phyir spros te 'khod pa 'di kho na bzhin dgongs pa yin no/ /deng sang gi lag len pa dag mdun bskyed gsum char la gtso bo mngon byang lngas bskyed/ 'khor rnams de'i thugs ka nas 'byin par byed pa ni rgyud 'grel gyi dgongs pa yang ma yin cing / rje bla ma'i dgongs pa yang ma yin te/ tshogs gnyis snye mar de nas tshom bu dbus ma'i steng du rang gi sems so sor rtog pa zhes sogs nas mngon byang lngas gtso bo bskyed/

'khor rnams dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi tshul gyis bskyed pa nas brtsam te zhes dang / dbang gi snye mar bum pa sta gon gyis skabs su rnam rgyal bum par mngon byang lngas gtso bo yab yum bum pa gzhan rnams su 'khor rnams 'byin pa'i tshul du bskyed de zhes dang / mdun bskyed bsgrub pa'i skabs su rang shar phyogs kyi sgo khang na gnas pa'i thugs ka nas yi ge hūm̐ spros la de dkyil 'khor gyi dbus kyi mtshan ma la thim pas de rang gi sems so sor rtog par mos la/ dang po sbyor ba'i tshul gyis gtso bo bskyed/ de nas dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi tshul gyis 'khor rnams thugs ka nas spros mdzad pa mdzad/ slar 'dus so so'i mtshan ma dang ro gcig tu gyur pa las 'khor rnams bskyed do zhes gsungs pa'i thugs ka nas spro ba bdag bskyed kho na la dgongs par tshig 'gros de nyid kyis kyang shes pa'i phyir dang / rgyud 'grel chen po'i dgongs pa ltar mdzad pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes pa 'di ni rang nyid dran pa gso ba dang / rnam dpyod dang ldan zhing blo gzu bor gnas pa 'ga' zhig la phan pa'i phyir du rgyud gsum smra ba bsod nams seng ges bris pa'o// ༄/ /dbang chu chen mo'i sa chog gi gsal byed bzhugs// ༈ /dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i rigs bdag rdo rje 'chang / /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal nas/ /bdud dpung tshar gcod sa gzhi byin brlab pa'i/ /cho ga'i rim pa gsal por bri bar bya/ /thog mar sa bslang phyogs skyong rnam gnyis la/ /zhi bas bslang zhing bgegs rnams drag pos bskrad/ /bgegs sbyang dbus dang phyogs bzhir slob dpon lnga/ /phyi nang mchod pa dang bcas 'dug nas ni/ /gnas mchod byin brlabs phyogs bzhi'i slob dpon gyis/ /dga' chen khyod bdag sogs kyis gsol ba gdab/ /kun gyis rnal 'byor rdzogs par bsgoms rjes su/ /phyogs bzhir gnas pas phyi nang mchod pas mchod/

/sprul phyir tshigs bcad bzhi yis gsol ba gdab/ /dkyil 'khor bteg ste rnam lnga 'dod skor gyis/ /rdo rje dril 'dzin langs nas mig rkang rnams/ /byin brlabs bgegs rnams tshar bcad rjes gzung bya/ /rdo rje'i 'gros kyis dbang ldan mtshams gnas nas/ /gar bslang 'gying btsal bsdig pa rnam gsum bya/ /de rjes zhi 'gros gsum dang khro 'gros kyis/ /dkyil 'khor sa gzhi g.yas skor dag tu bcag /shar nas brtsams te phyogs bzhir g.yas brkyang dang / /g.yon brkyang sa ga zlum po rim bzhin bya/ /dbang ldan nas brtsams mtshams bzhir rdo rje dang / /mnyam dang rus sbal bung ba rim bzhin bya/ /slar yang dbus dang phyogs bzhir rdo rje dang / /'khor lo rin chen pad+ma ral gri bya/ /de rjes dbus su mdung tshul lan gsum dang / /shar du gzhu dbyig tho ba'i tshul gsum bya/ /gtun shing rdo rje rtse gcig kha bcu lhor/ /chu gri sna tshogs dbyig pa mdung thung nub/ /mtshon rtse gcig dang ba dan gnyis gsum byang / /tshul bcu drug dang mchod pa gnyis byas nas/ /dbang ldan me tog sgeg dang gling bu gsum/ /mer ni bdug spos phreng ba pi wang gsum/ /srin por mar me glu dang rdza rnga gsum/ /rlung du dri dang gar ma rnga zlum gsum/ /slar yang dbus su 'dug stangs bcu bya ste/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i pad+ma'i skyil krung dang / /skyil krung phyed pa bzang po bkra shis dpa'/ /rol pa mdun dang phyir blta 'dug stangs bcu/ /sgeg sogs sku gsung thugs kyi nyams dgu dang / /drug gi rjes su skyes sogs glu yi rigs/ /bcu dgu byas te 'di dag gom stabs dang / /lag stabs 'dug stangs ngag gi 'dren pa'o/ /slar yang dbang ldan mtshams nas bgegs tshogs la/ /bka' bsgo bya ste rdo rje phur bu'i tshogs/ /thugs ka nas sprul phyogs skyong bcu bkug nas/ /phur bus gdab pa sa yi cho ga'o// //da ni de dag gi don zhib tu bshad par bya ste/

dbang chu chen mor sa'i cho ga la don drug tu gsungs pa'i dang po gnyis dang / snang ba la bslang ba la sa'i cho ga med pas/ mi snang ba la bslang ba nas brtsams te/ gang du dkyil 'khor byed pa'i sa phyogs der/ dbus su maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du sa'i lha mo'i tshom bu dgod/ de'i g.yas su chu bzhi/ g.yon du nyer spyod lnga/ mdun du gtor ma gnyis bsham/ slob dpon dpon slob rnams kyi mdun du nang mchod rdo rje dril bu bshams te/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ tshad med bzhi/ ye shes tshogs bsag sngon du song nas/ gtso bo yab yum rdo rje cho ga gsum las bskyed pa yan lag bzhi rdzogs su byas nas rtsa ba'i sngags nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas te/ thog mar sa'i lha mo la bslang ba ni/ sa lha sta gon gyi skabs ji lta ba bzhin du bya ste/ sa'i lha mo dpang po'i tshul gyis nam mkha' la 'degs par bya'o/ /de nas gtor ma gnyis pa mkha' 'gro spyi gtor ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros te/ phyogs skyong 'khor dang bcas pa bkug par bsam zhing / lus kyis lcags kyu'i phyag rgya bca'/ ngag tu oṃ da sha dika lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drang / sa pa ri wā ra zhes pa'i rjes la a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul te/ nang mchod kyis kyang mchod nas/ sa'i lha mo la bslang ba'i skabs kyi tshig lhug pa brjod de dril bu gsil bar bya'o/ /de nas gtor ma de nyid kyi lhag ma byin brlab mi dgos par/ oṃ sarba big+nan na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo zhes sogs lan gsum gyis bgegs la byin nas/ sa phyogs 'dir ni slob dpon bdag /ces sogs brjod de/ gu gul gyi dud pa dang / nyungs kar gyi thun dang / rol mo'i sgra drag tu bya'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gsar du bya ba'i sar las dang bya bas skyon sbyang ba bya dgos na'ang / dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa grub pa'i sar de'i tshab tu/

lag pa g.yas pa sa la bzhag ste/ oṃ ha na ha na kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa mang du bzla/ oṃ bhu kham̐ swā hā/ zhes bzlas te/ sa phyogs nam mkha'i rang bzhin du bsam mo/ /de nas ting nge 'dzin gyis bgegs sbyang ba'i phyir/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi der thun mong ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lo dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lo hūm̐ mdzad dbus su byas pa gnyis bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi'i dbus su stan nang tshangs can la slob dpon kha shar du phyogs te 'dug phyogs bzhir slob dpon bzhi 'dug ste/ mdun du chu bzhi sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod lnga dang / nang mchod rdo rje dril bu bsham/ thog mar gnas dang mchod pa'i yo byad byin brlab bya ste/ phyogs bzhi'i slob dpon gyis dga' chen khyod bdag lan gsum gyis gtso bo la gsol ba gdab/ dpon slob kun gyis bdag bskyed yongs su rdzogs pa bzlas pa dang bcas pa byas te/ phyogs bzhi'i slob dpon gyis lha sta gon la mi 'jug na dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bsdus/ 'jug na 'og tu gtso bo dang mnyam du dkyil 'khor nam mkhar 'degs par bya ba yin pas/ mchod pa byin rlabs sngon du 'gro ba'i phyi mchod dang nang mchod kyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun zhi ba/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad bzhis rim pa bzhin gsol ba gdab/ de nas gtso bo'am slob dpon lnga char gyis rdo rje khu tshur gyi mtheb chung gnyis sbrel/ mdzub mo gnyis rtse sprad pa'i phyag rgya spyi bor bzlog ste/ hūm̐ badz+ra ut+tiṣ+ṭha/ rang gis bsgoms pa'i rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor nam mkhar bzhugs te/ rang gtso bo las bye ba'i he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis par gyur zhes brjod la/ rnam lnga 'dod skor sngon du 'gro bas/ oṃ ma hā badz+ra hūm̐ zhes pas rdo rje blang / oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe aḥzhes pas dril bu blang ste/ rdo rje gsor te skyil krung g.yas pa bshig

dril bu gsil te skyil krung g.yon pa bshig rnam lnga 'dod skor gyis langs te/ mig rkang byin gyis brlab pa dang / bgegs tshar gcad pa dang / gsos par byas nas g.yas sngon 'gro'i gzhi bca' sngon du 'gro bas/ dga' ba yongs gyur gyi 'gros kyis dbang ldan du song ste/ kha nang du phyogs nas gar bslang ba dang / gar gyi 'gying btsal ba dang / gar bsdig pa lan gsum gsum bya'o/ /dga' ba yongs gyur ni/ ngag du oṃ zhes dang / rkang pa g.yon pa g.yas pa'i mgor rkang mgo g.yas su bsten te gzhag ni zhes dang / rkang pa g.yas pa'i mgo g.yon pa'i rgyab phyogs su gzhag sum+bha zhes dang / g.yon pa'i dkyil g.yas pa'i rting pa la gzhag badz+ra zhes dang / g.yas pa g.yon pa'i mdun du mgo g.yon du rten te gzhag hūm̐ zhes dang / g.yon pa'i mgo g.yas pa'i rgyab tu gzhag phaṭa ces dang / g.yas pa'i dkyil g.yon pa'i rting par gzhag pa'o/ /gar bslang ba ni lus g.yo ba dang bcas te/ gar skor gyi rjes su rdo rje gsor/ dril bu gsil ba'o/ /bgying btsal ba ni rkang pa g.yas pa g.yon pa'i mdun nas bskor te sngar shul du gzhag pa dang / gar skor gyi rjes su g.yas rdo rje thugs ka dang / g.yon dril bu dkur gzhag pa'am/ khu tshur gnyis kha gyen du bstan nas rked par 'jog pa gang rung bya'o/ /bsdig pa ni rkang pa g.yas pa mdun nas bskor te sa la brdab pa dang / gar skor bya rjes su lag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas te bsnun pa dus mnyam du bya ba'o/ /zhi 'gros gsum la rgya mtsho bskyod pa ni/ lag pa gar skor dang / rkang pa gnyis res mos kyis mdun nas bskor te g.yab kyin 'gro ba'o/ /ri bo 'degs pa ni gom pa g.yon pa mdun du g.yab kyin spo ba'i tshe lag pa gar skor gyi rjes su/ g.yas phyogs su ri bo 'degs pa'i tshul bya zhing / g.yas pa spo ba'i tshe g.yon phyogs su bya ba res mos su bya ba'o/ /mdzes pa'i gom pa ni mdun du spo ba ngos mdun nas g.yab cing mi spo ba ngos kyi brla la btsugs nas khyim bya'i gom pa ltar byas te 'gro ba'o/

/khro bo'i gom pa ni rkang pa g.yon mdun du brdab pa'i tshe lag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas te brkyangs nas g.yon dril bu snying gar gsil/ rkang pa g.yas pa mdun du brdab pa'i tshe lag pa g.yas rdo rje snying gar gzung zhing / g.yon dril bu dang bcas pa brkyangs te gsil ba res mos kyis 'gro ba'o/ /gom stabs bzhi po 'di dag la hum̐ thung re re brjod par bya'o/ /'di man chad kyi spyi 'gro ni dbus nas phyir 'gro ba'i tshe na'ang dbang ldan du 'gro/ phyi nas dbus su 'gro ba na'ang dbang ldan nas 'gro/ 'gros thams cad ni dga' ba yongs gyur gyis 'gro/ phyogs re re la gar bca' ba gsum/ sgrub pa gsum/ bsdu ba gsum ste dgu dgu bya/ rkang stabs brgyad la sgrub pa'i tshe phyag rgya gcig la gnas nas g.yas g.yon dbus gsum du blta/ tshul dang po lnga la phyag rgya re re'ang bca' thebs lan gsum gsum bya/ dbus su mdung gi tshul yang de dang 'dra/ phyogs bzhi'i tshul gsum gsum dang / mtshams bzhi'i mchod pa gsum gsum ni sgrub pa'i tshe phyag rgya re re so sor 'cha' ba'o/ /tshul bcu drug man chad kyi rkang stabs ni dbus dang mtshams bzhir mnyam pa dang / phyogs bzhir g.yas brkyang sogs rtsa ba'i rkang stabs bya/ bca' ba'i tshe gang sngon du 'gro ba'i rkang pa mdun nas skor gcig bskor te cig shos kyi mdun du mgo phyir bstan nas gzhag de nas cig shos mdun nas bskor te rkang stabs gang yin pa de'i tshul du gzhag de nas snga ma mdun nas bskor te rkang stabs de nyid la gnas de lta bu'i bca' ba gsum dang / sgrub pa gsum dang / bsdu ba dang po gnyis la/ hūm̐ ngar sgra dang bcas pa ring bar brjod/ bsdu ba phyi ma la hum̐ thung brjod/ bsdu ba'i tshe sngon la gang 'gro dang por bsdus te sngar shul du gzhag de nas cig shos mdun nas bskor te sngar shul du gzhag slar yang snga ma mdun nas bskor te sngar shul du gzhag pa'o/

/da ni so so'i ngo bo bshad par bya ste/ g.yas brkyang ni g.yas sngon 'gro'i mtho lnga rnam par brkyangs pa'i g.yas brkyang dang / lag pa gnyis rgyab sbyar ba'i mdzub mo gnyis dang / mthe'u chung gnyis sbrel nas bzhin khros pa'i tshul lo/ /g.yon brkyang ni g.yon sngon 'gro'i mtho lnga rnam par brkyangs pa'i g.yon brkyang dang / phyag rgya sngar gyi la mdzub mo gnyis bsgreng ba dang bzhin khros pa'o/ /sa ga ni g.yon sngon 'gro'i rkang pa gnyis cung zad bgrad pa'i bar khru gang dang sor gnyis su byas te pus mo drang por bsrang / g.yas rdo rje snying ga dang / g.yon dril bu dkur bzung nas bzhin zhi ba'o/ /zlum po ni g.yas sngon 'gro'i rkang pa bgrad pa'i pus mo gnyis kyi bar khru dor byas te ngang pa'i gshog pa lta bu dang / lag pa gnyis phyogs mtshams thams cad du gar byed cing bzhin skrag pa'i tshul lo/ /rdo rje ni g.yas sngon 'gro'i rkang pa g.yas kyi rting pa g.yon gyi mthil du btsugs pa dang / phyag rgya sa ga dang 'dra'o/ /mnyam pa ni g.yas sngon 'gro'i rkang pa gnyis gshibs te bsrang ba dang / lag gnyis rdo rje dril bu dkur bzung ba'o/ /rus sbal ni g.yas sngon 'gro'i rkang pa g.yon pa'i bol gong du g.yas pa'i mthil bzhag nas lag gnyis dpung pa'i thad kar bskum me byas pa'o/ /bung ba ni g.yas sngon 'gro'i brla g.yon par g.yas pa'i mthil gtad nas lag gnyis mthil gdengs pa dang sgeg pa'i bzhin no/ /rdo rje ni lag g.yon snying gar sdigs mdzub dang g.yas pa rdo rje 'phyar ba'i tshul lo/ /'khor lo ni snying gar rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kha gyen la bstan/ mthe'u chung dang mdzub mo gnyis phan tshun sbrel ba 'khor lo bskor ba ltar byas nas g.yas phyogs su gyen la 'phyar ba'i tshul lo/ /rin po che ni rin po che'i phyag rgya khu tshur gnyis sbyar ba'i gung mo gnyis bsgrengs nas mtheb mdzub sbyar te dpral bar 'jog pa'o/

/pad+ma ni snyim pa pad+ma kha phye ba'i tshul lo/ /ral gri ni g.yas pa'i mthe bong srin lag dang mthe'u chung gis mnan nas g.yon pa'i rdo rje khu tshur gyis shubs nas phyung nas 'phyar ba'o/ /mdung ni rdo rje khu tshur gyi mdzub mo gnyis bsgrengs nas g.yas g.yon dbus gsum du bsnun pa'i tshul lo/ /gzhu ni gzhu 'gengs pa'i tshul lo/ /dbyug pa ni g.yon sdigs mdzub/ g.yas pa dbyug pa 'phyar ba'i tshul lo/ /tho ba ni lag pa gnyis tho ba 'degs pa'i tshul lo/ /gtun shing ni gtun shing gis 'bras dru ba'i tshul lo/ /rdo rje rtse gcig pa ni rdo rje bsdams pa'i gung mo gnyis bsgreng ba'o/ /kha bcu pa ni snyim pa'i sor mo bcu phyogs bcur gdengs nas bskyod pa'o/ /chu gri ni g.yas pas chu gris gcod pa lta bu'o/ /sna tshogs dbyig pa ni phyogs kun tu dbyig pa bskor te brdeg pa'i tshul lo/ /mdung thung ni g.yon sdigs mdzub g.yas khu tshur gyis mdung thung g.yas su bsnun pa'i tshul lo/ /mtshon rtse gcig ni gsor mdung 'phen pa'i tshul te tshul bcu drug go /ba dan gnyis dang gsum ni g.yas pa'i sor mo gnyis dang gsum ston pa'o/ /mchod pa bcu gnyis ni rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kha gyen du 'thor ba dang / thur du dbub pa dang / mthe bong gnyis bsgreng ba dang / byug pa'i tshul lo/ /yang rdo rje khu tshur gnyis dkur bzhag nas mgo g.yon du 'dud pa dang / phreng ba 'bul ba dang / khu tshur gnyis sbyar nas kha nas 'dren pa dang / spyi bor gar byed pa'i tshul lo/ /yang lag pa gnyis kyis gling bu bsgyur ba dang / pi wang bsgreng ba dang / rdza rnga brdung ba dang / mu kun ta brdung ba'i tshul lo/ /lus kyi 'dug stangs bcu ni ngag tu hūm̐ brjod cing / sems kyis rdo rje'i sa gzhir bsgom mo/ /rdo rje'i skyil krung ni g.yas pa'i byin pa dang brla sbyar ba'i steng du g.yon pa'i bol bzhag nas phyi nas g.yas pa g.yon gyi steng du gzhag cing lag pa gnyis ka sa gnon gyi phyag rgya dang zhi ba'i bzhin no/

/sems dpa'i ni brla g.yon gyi steng du g.yas kyi bol bzhag nas g.yon gyi byin pa rkang 'og tu bzhag nas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang snying rje'i bzhin no/ /pad+ma'i ni long bu gnyis bsnol nas bol gnyis ma reg par mthe bong gnyis rtse sprad de/ pus mo gnyis sa la sbyar ba'am cung zad bteg cing ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya dang snying rje'i bzhin no/ /phyed pa ni g.yon gyi brla la g.yas pa'i bol bzhag nas g.yon brkyangs te gnyis ka mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang snying rje'i bzhin no/ /bzang po ni rkang pa gnyis stan mtho ba'i steng nas brkyangs nas mthil phab nas gnyis ka skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang snying rje'i bzhin no/ /bkra shis ni rkang pa gnyis bar mtho gang tsam du byas te tsog pu ba 'jo ba'i tshul du 'dug nas lag pa gnyis pus mo so so'i steng du rkyalaṃ ba dang rmad du byung ba'i zhal lo/ /dpa' bo ni g.yas pa sa la btsugs pa'i long bu la g.yon pa'i mthil gtad de/ lag pa so so'i steng du bzhag pa dang dpa' ba'i bzhin no/ /rol pa'i ni rkang pa g.yas phyed skyil du byas te g.yon cung zad cig mdun du brkyangs nas lag pa g.yon pa'i mthil rgyab g.yon du sa la btsugs te/ g.yas pas phyag mtshan 'dzin pa'i tshul du pus mo g.yas kyi steng du gzhag pa dang rmad du byung ba'i zhal lo/ /mdun du lta ba ni 'dug stangs de nyid la gnas pas lag pa gnyis slar bcas te mig mdun du bltas te rdo rje'i sa gzhir bsgoms te khro bo'i bzhin no/ /phyir bltas kyang lag pa gnyis brlar bcas te gzhan 'dra ba las mig g.yas g.yon nas rgyab tu blta ba'o/ /rgyud dang dkyil chog gnyis las 'dug stangs dang po drug las ma gsungs kyang / shar pa rdo rje 'od zer gyis phyi ma bzhi rgyud gzhan nas kha bskang ba ni spros pa la dga' ba'i dbang du byas pa yin no/ /rgyud 'dir dang po drug gis kyang chog go

/nyams dgu la sgeg pa ni ya sos ma mchu cung zad mnan cing 'dzum pa'o/ /dpa' ba ni mig dpangs stod de nyam nga ba dang bag tsha ba med pa'o/ /mi sdug pa ni bzhin shin tu bsdus pa'o/ /dgod pa ni kha gdangs nas ha ha'i sgra sgrogs pa'o/ /drag shul ni brdeg pa'am shin tu khros pa'o/ /'jigs su rung ba ni 'jigs pa'i rnam pa can no/ /snying rje dang rngam pa ni byams pa ste mig zim pa dang bcas pa'o/ /zhi ba ni bzhin drang por 'jog pa'o/ /glu'i bkod pa rnams kyang rang rang gi nyams ci lta ba bzhin du bya'o/ /slar yang dbang ldan gyi mtshams su gnas te kha nang du bltas nas/ hūm̐/ lus ngag sems la gnas pa yi/ /zhes sogs lan gsum gyis bgegs la bka' bsgos te re re'i mtshams su'ang rol mo drag tu bya'o/ /de nas phur bu bcu mdun du nas kyi tshom bu'i steng du gzhag re re la'ang nyungs kar gyi thum bu dang dar dmar po'i con paṇa gyis brgyan/ rang gi snying ga nas rdo rje phur bu stod khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i rnam pa can/ lte ba man chad mdung rtse gcig pa'i dbyibs can bcu spros par bsam/ spros pa la dga' na gnas gsum byin rlabs dang ye shes pa bcug slar yang snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas bgegs kyi gtso bo phyogs skyong bcu bkug nas phyogs mtshams brgyad/ shar gyi g.yas dang / nub kyi g.yon du bkod par bsams la/ gnas de dag tu phur khung bkod pa la shar nas brtsams te/ nub kyi g.yon gyi bar du phur bu btab ste/ rkang pa g.yas pa'i mthil dang / g.yon pa'i pus mo sa la btsugs/ lag pa g.yon pas phur bu gzung / g.yas pas tho ba'am/ rdo rjes brdungs te/ oṃ gha gha sogs brjod/ de'i tshe rol mo'i sgra drag tu bya'o/ /de nas phur bu dang bgegs kyi ro las 'od byung ba'i tshul gyis rdo rje'i sa gzhi sogs thun mong ba'i srung 'khor bsgom par bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i sa gzhi byin rlob pa'i/

/cho ga'i tshul 'di rgyud dang gzhung bzang gi /dgongs pa ji bzhin bla ma'i phyag len gyis/ gsal bar brgyan te rgyud gsum smra bas bkod/ /de las byung ba'i rab dkar dge ba'i tshogs/ /ji snyed thob des mkha' mnyam 'gro ba yi/ /bdud dang log 'dren tshogs rnams rab bcom nas/ /phan bde rgya mtsho'i dpal la spyod par shog/ //dge'o// ༄༅/ /bla ma dang dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rten rnying pa la bya ba'i ar+gha'i cho ga ni/ ngan pa bzang por spo ba dang / dma' ba nas mtho bar spo ba dang / rnying pa gso ba rnams la rung gi gzhan la ni mi rung ngo / /ji ltar bya ba ni rten de'i drung du/ chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod dang / gtor ma gcig bsham/ rang yi dam gang 'dod kyi bsgom bzlas rdzogs par bya ste/ mchod pa bsang sbyang byin rlabs byas nas/ tshigs bcad dang sngags gang yang rung bas mchod/ rten de nyid kyi bstod pa'am rigs lnga'i bstod pas bstod/ gtor ma'ang bsang sbyang byin rlabs byas nas/ a kā ro'i sngags kyis chos skyong la dbul/ bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du bde bar gshegs pa'i rten rnying pa spo ba'am/ gso bar 'tshal zhing / de'ang sang nangs par bgyid par 'tshal zhes pa'am/ da ni bgyid par 'tshal zhes pa skabs thob dang sbyar te gsol ba gdab/ de nas me long g.ya' yongs su dag pa gcig smyug ma la btags pa rten de'i drung du btsugs te gzugs brnyan 'char du bcug la 'di ltar bsams te/ rten 'di gang zag khyad par can gyis rab tu gnas par byas pa yin na'ang / me long gi gzugs brnyan la spo bar rung ste/ de'i rgyu mtshan rten 'di bden na me long gi nang gi gzugs brnyan yang bden/ me long gi nang gi gzugs brnyan yang mi bden na rten 'di'ang mi bden pa'i phyir te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis chos thams cad me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ltar mi bden par gsungs pa'i phyir ro snyam du yun ring du bsam/

de nas me long nang gi gzugs brnyan de'i nang du rten de'i dam tshig pa bskyed/ po ti sogs yin na bsgyur gzhi gang yin pa de bskyed/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlab/ ye shes pa bcug pa'i tshab tu rten rnying pa de'i ye shes pa bcug la mchod bstod bsdus pa byas nas steng 'og mi 'khrul pa'i mtshan ma byas te/ dar ser pos g.yogs pa'i rgyab ngos su rgyas btab la/ rten gsar pa de'i rab gnas byed byed du kha mi dbye bar mchod pa dang bcas te dben par gzhag go /de nas rten gsar pa'i rab gnas kyi ye shes pa gzhug pa'i tshe me long kha phye ste de'i nang gi lha'ang rten gsar pa la gzhug cho ga gzhan rnams rab gnas kyi dkyus bzhin du bya'o/ /rten rnying pa'i sa rdo rnams gsar pa la bsre ba'am/ chu'i skye bo la phan pa'i phyir du chu nang du blug pa'am mchod rten lta bur byas te rab gnas byed pa gang rung bya'o/ /rten rnying pa la bya ba'i ar+gha'i cho ga sngags 'chang dge 'dun blo gros kyis bskul ba'i ngor/ rje btsun chen po'i dgongs pa bzhin bsod nams seng ges bris nas mdo khams su phul ba'o// ༈ //dge ba 'di yis dus gsum gyi/ /rgyal ba kun gyi gsang chen mdzod/ /bla med mchog gi bstan pa ni/ /dar rgyas yun du gnas gyur cig /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 go bo rab 'byams pa/ kyai rdo rje man ngag lugs kyi mchod gtor gyi rnal 'byor sogs chos tshan lnga/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
